parameters.name: Config
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable vulnerability detection. Valid values:

*   **on**: yes
*   **off**: no

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the request.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of the vulnerability. Valid values:

*   **cve**: Linux software vulnerability
*   **sys**: Windows system vulnerability
*   **cms**: Web-CMS vulnerability
*   **emg**: urgent vulnerability

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas modify-vul-target-config --source-ip 1.2.XX.XX --type cve --uuid inet-7c676676-06fa-442e-90fb-b802e5d60000 --config off --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas ModifyVulTargetConfig --region cn-hangzhou --Type cve --SourceIp '1.2.XX.XX' --Uuid 'inet-7c676676-06fa-442e-90fb-b802e5d60000' --Config off
